objective: Minimize raw total energy * final simulation clock. Waiting and turnaround are diagnostics only.
environment: gcc:13 Linux amd64 Docker on Apple Silicon; read-only source mounts; network none; -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror; callback work audit enabled

controls.original: Eight-core scheduler before predicted capacity and warm reserve
controls.previous: Previous waiting-oriented wake comparison and warm reserve
controls.edp: EDP-only evaluation; preserve measured short-stream recipe; compare full batch energy/time for long running work

verification: 60 completed benchmark runs, identical paired work and ownership checks. Final source passes 27 correctness runs, including EDP regression ceilings; overlapping counters match paired benchmarks. Final EDP does not increase versus either control on any of 20 workloads.

reproduction_sources.run.sh:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
renames='-DCreateProcess=PolicyCreateProcess -DExitProcess=PolicyExitProcess -DTimerInterrupt=PolicyTimerInterrupt -DCStateTransitionComplete=PolicyCStateTransitionComplete -DSimulationComplete=PolicySimulationComplete'
g++ -std=gnu++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -DEEC_CHECK_CALLBACK_WORK -I/work/src -c /analysis/driver.cpp -o /tmp/driver.o
g++ -std=gnu++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -I/work/src -c /work/src/ready_queue.cpp -o /tmp/queue.o
for policy in original previous edp; do
    case "$policy" in
        original) source=/analysis/original.cpp ;;
        previous) source=/analysis/previous.cpp ;;
        edp) source=/work/src/scheduler.cpp ;;
    esac
    g++ -std=gnu++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -I/work/src $renames -c "$source" -o /tmp/policy.o
    g++ /tmp/driver.o /tmp/policy.o /tmp/queue.o -L/work/src -lsim -Wl,-rpath,/work/src -Wl,--wrap=_Z11LoadContextjj -Wl,--wrap=_Z11SaveContextjj -o /tmp/benchmark
    printf 'POLICY %s\n' "$policy"
    for scenario in seed:0 seed:1 seed:2 seed:3 seed:4 seed:5 single long burst gaps mixed boundary late zero short-gaps long-gaps changing-gaps timeout-demand wake-overtake wake-parallel; do
        /tmp/benchmark "$scenario"
    done
done
